comment: Verified on a 2019 Tacoma (2GR-FKS 3.5L V6). Seven standard mode-01 PIDs plus odometer (standard PID A6) are read via functional OBD on 7DF->7E8; physical 7E0 does not respond on this truck, so they use the functional header (ATSH7DF) and must not use ATSH7E0;ATCRA7E8; as the Corolla/Sienna profiles do. Fuel level uses the combination meter (7C0 21 29, B3/2 litres) because standard 01 2F is not supported here; cross-checked against the dash gauge.
